comments.zh: 守卫源实体（条目）——Name/Score/Kind 为谓词输入。
comments.en: Guard the source entity (entry) — Name/Score/Kind serve as predicate inputs.

comments.zh: <summary>条目主键</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Entry primary key</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>名称（命名方法组谓词入参）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Name (predicate input for named method group)</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>分值（内联谓词入参）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Score (predicate input for inline lambda)</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>分类（T2 整源谓词判定输入）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Category (predicate input for T2 full-source predicate)</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>有界源值（组合专用——独立于自动同名属性 Score，显式 .Map 与其同锚点 MapWhen 共享）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Bounded source value (dedicated to composition — independent of the auto-mapped property Score; explicitly .Map shares the same anchor point with MapWhen)</summary>

comments.zh: Fluent 侧守卫 DTO——四个属性各锚一种谓词形态（命名方法组 / 内联转录 / 整源 / 同锚点组合）。
comments.en: Fluent-side guard DTO — each of the four properties anchors a distinct predicate form (named method group / inline transcription / full-source / same-anchor composition).

comments.zh: <summary>条目主键（自动同名，无守卫）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Entry primary key (auto-mapped by name, no guard)</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>名称（命名静态方法组谓词 HasContent）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Name (named static method group predicate HasContent)</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>分值（无捕获内联 lambda 谓词，转录进生成代码）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Score (capture-free inline lambda predicate, transcribed into generated code)</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>分类标签（T2 整源谓词 + 显式 Map——条件→转换→赋值）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Category tag (T2 full-source predicate + explicit .Map — condition → transformation → assignment)</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>有界分值（同锚点：.Member(d => d.BoundedScore).From(s => s.BoundedSource) + .Member(d => d.BoundedScore).MapWhen()——条件假则跳过赋值）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Bounded score (same anchor: .Member(d => d.BoundedScore).From(s => s.BoundedSource) + .Member(d => d.BoundedScore).MapWhen() — assignment skipped if condition evaluates to false)</summary>

comments.zh: 谓词宿主类——A 形态命名静态方法组（须 public/internal static + 同程序集可见）。
comments.en: Predicate host class — Form A: named static method group (must be public/internal static and visible within the same assembly).

comments.zh: <summary>T1 字段值谓词——非空非空白</summary>
comments.en: <summary>T1 field-value predicate — non-null and non-whitespace</summary>

comments.zh: <param name="value">源字段值</param>
comments.en: <param name="value">Source field value</param>

comments.zh: <returns>true 才映射</returns>
comments.en: <returns>true to perform mapping</returns>

comments.zh: <summary>T2 整源谓词——单参 == 源实体类型判 T2（与 Convert 族同规则）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>T2 full-source predicate — single parameter equals source entity type for T2 classification (same rules as the Convert family)</summary>

comments.zh: <param name="src">源实体</param>
comments.en: <param name="src">Source entity</param>

comments.zh: <returns>Kind=="A" 才映射</returns>
comments.en: <returns>true to map only when Kind=="A"</returns>

comments.zh: Fluent 侧守卫 Mapper（对应 how-to/fluent/terminals.md「MapWhen」节）——
comments.en: Fluent-side guard Mapper (corresponding to the 'MapWhen' section in how-to/fluent/terminals.md) —

comments.zh: 命名方法组 + 内联转录 + 整源 + 同锚点（Map+MapWhen）四形态同链。
comments.en: Four predicate forms in one chain: named method group + inline transcription + full-source + same-anchor (.Map + .MapWhen).

comments.zh: <summary>链式声明入口（方法名任意，签名固定）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Chained declaration entry point (method name arbitrary, signature fixed)</summary>

comments.zh: <param name="cfg">Fluent 配置根</param>
comments.en: <param name="cfg">Fluent configuration root</param>

comments.zh: 特性侧守卫 DTO（对应 how-to/fluent/terminals.md「MapWhen」节的特性通道）——
comments.en: Attribute-side guard DTO (corresponding to the attribute channel in the 'MapWhen' section of how-to/fluent/terminals.md) —

comments.zh: [MapWhen(nameof(HasContent))] 属性级：谓词方法在被标注属性的声明类型上按名解析（单类型自足）；
comments.en: [MapWhen(nameof(HasContent))] Attribute-level: predicate method resolved by name on the declaring type of the annotated property (self-contained within a single type);

comments.zh: Inherited=true 随属性继承（与钩子特性 Inherited=false 不同）。
comments.en: Inherited=true means the attribute is inherited (unlike hook attributes with Inherited=false).

comments.zh: <summary>条目主键（自动同名）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Entry primary key (automatically named identically).</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>名称（[MapWhen] 属性级守卫——谓词 HasContent 声明于本类型）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Name ([MapWhen] property-level guard—predicate HasContent is declared in this type).</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>分值（自动同名，无守卫）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>Score (automatically named identically, no guard).</summary>

comments.zh: <summary>T1 字段值谓词（public static，签名 bool(string)——与 [Convert(string)] 单参形态同规则）</summary>
comments.en: <summary>T1 field value predicate (public static, signature bool(string)—same rules as the single-parameter [Convert(string)] form).</summary>

comments.zh: <param name="value">源字段值</param>
comments.en: <param name="value">Source field value.</param>

comments.zh: <returns>true 才映射</returns>
comments.en: <returns>true to perform mapping.</returns>
